prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you need someone for a home irrigation system or for a business/commercial device? Also tell me your ZIP or a nearby cross-street so I can target recommendations.

Meanwhile, here are quick, practical ways to find certified backflow testers and repair techs near Liberty, MO:

1. Contact the City of Liberty Water/Public Works
- Many cities keep a list of approved or certified backflow testers and can tell you submission requirements. They can also confirm whether your device needs annual testing.

2. Search for certified backflow testers
- Look for plumbers or irrigation companies that advertise “backflow testing” or “backflow assembly tester (BAT)” certification. Good places to search: Google Maps, Yelp, Angi (formerly Angie’s List), HomeAdvisor, and Thumbtack.
- Search phrase examples: “backflow testing Liberty MO”, “backflow tester near 64068” (use your ZIP).

3. Check credentials
- Ask for the tester’s BAT or state/local certification, proof of calibration for their test gauge, and insurance.
- Make sure they will submit the test report (or permit) to the City/utility if required.

4. Get multiple quotes
- Testing typically runs ~$50–$150 per device; repairs/parts are extra (repair costs vary widely depending on the part — $75–$400+ in many cases). Ask for an estimate before work.

5. Types of providers to call
- Local plumbing companies (service & repair)
- Irrigation/sprinkler companies (common for residential backflow devices)
- Specialty backflow testing firms or certified utility contractors

If you want, give me your ZIP code (or confirm residential vs commercial) and I’ll suggest likely local providers and exact search queries you can paste into Google or Yelp.
